description: TEMPLATE per-app environment config. Copy to env_config.{APP}.json (e.g. env_config.BREW.json), register the file name in pipeline-config.json → apps.{APP}.envConfig, and fill in the values. NEVER hardcode credentials here — reference environment variables only.
_urlNotes: appUrl = browser base URL for UI stories (Planner writes it). apiBaseUrl = base URL for API-only stories. At least one must be set before Scripting (URL gate).

credentials.note: DO NOT hardcode credentials. Reference environment variables (loaded from qe-pipeline/.env) by name only.

endpoints._doc: Optional. Named API endpoint paths this app's tests hit, used by the execution health check to probe the SPECIFIC endpoint (not just the host). Example: "getUser": "/v1/users/{id}".
